description.en: Returns the number of frames elapsed since the engine last updated (the per-frame delta, normally 1.0 but can differ if the game is running slower/faster than expected). Used to build frame-rate-independent timers and countdowns in event scripts.
Elapsed frame count since the previous update.

example.code:
// Decrement a countdown by the real elapsed time instead of a fixed step
wait_frm_now -= CMND_GET_ELASPED_FRAME();
